fix_summary.root_cause: TOCTOU (time-of-check-to-time-of-use) race condition in _ensure_parent_directory where another process could create the parent directory between the exists() check and mkdir() call
fix_summary.solution: Changed exist_ok=False to exist_ok=True in parent.mkdir() to handle race condition atomically

risks.security_impact: positive - fixes race condition that could cause unexpected errors
